title: Input symbol at a prescribed position
statement: For a Boolean finite Turing machine $M$, a configuration $c$ on input $x$, a state $q$ of the augmented machine or no state, and natural numbers $i,r$ with $i\le |x|$, the configuration formed from $c$ with input head at position $i+1$ scans exactly the $i$-th symbol of $x$, or no symbol if $i\ge |x|$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols
$q$ is an optional state of the augmented machine
